text_block_list.text: —Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival.
To show gratitude for their daily support, fans were invited onto the academy grounds to enjoy sports-related events with the Umamusume.
As for Bubble Gum Fellow—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Starting shortly:
The 'Slapstick Obstacle & Scavenger Race'!
GⅠ Umamusume of the current era will be competing!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Bubble Gum Fellow and Air Groove!
The ones who lit up last year's Classic races, huh~?
Talk about a stacked lineup!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's fracture looks completely
healed now...! She's as cool as ever~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I was worried after the Japan Cup,
but she looks well...! Bubble, good luck out there today~!!
...Watching the events from the stands, I could feel the excitement building among the fans when Bubble Gum Fellow and the others made their entrance.
Ever since the Japan Cup, Bubble Gum Fellow's period of perseverance has continued. However—

Her fans are patiently waiting for her.
Reassuring myself of that fact,
I felt a sense of relief wash over me...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: “—Aren't you super busy with student council work today too? And yet, entering the competitions anyway is so like you.”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Naturally. This Fan Thanksgiving Festival is an extremely precious opportunity for us to interact with our fans...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"After suffering a crushing defeat at the Shuka Sho,
and ending last year in pathetic fashion with a fracture,
I owe it to my fans to prove I am still standing strong."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Therefore, being busy is no excuse.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Showing the fans she's still in top form, huh.
...I could learn a thing or two from that.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I really love that about you.
It's so cool.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Spare me the flattery.
Focus on your competition instead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do not underestimate me just because I've recently recovered from illness.
This body of mine is already stronger than I was last year...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence.
—Me too!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All runners, on your marks—
Ready, GO!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble & Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Hah!!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow and Air Groove are the first to leap to the front!!
Both of them are moving with incredible speed!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow and Air Groove!
Charging ahead fearlessly through obstacles, breaking through one after another! Fast!! They're so fast!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
(Go for it! Bubble Gum Fellow!!
Keep it up! Air Groove!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—They've finally reached the final obstacle, the Scavenger Hunt!!
There's no gap between them at all!!
Will this contest be decided by the difficulty of their prompts!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! 
What an impossible demand...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's the vibe...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: If there's any to be found, it's this way!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and the two have split up!
Just what was the prompt!?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow is heading toward the grandstands!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Umm—

text_block_list.name: Child Fan
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, the real thing...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Hey, you there!
What you're holding in your hand, that's my Paka Puchi, right?

text_block_list.name: Child Fan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! I'm a huge fan!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yes, super lucky...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, ma'am! Could you spare
your child for just a moment, please?!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah, y-yes!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Could you lend me a hand for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Child Fan
text_block_list.text: Of course!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Now, hold on tight, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Child Fan
text_block_list.text: Waah! I-Incredible...!!

Bubble Gum Fellow tears through the wind
toward the goal, carrying a young fan on her back...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow is already back!
Did she manage to complete the prompt—!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
My topic is—
"A fan holding merchandise of me"!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent!!
Bubble Gum Fellow crosses the finish line in 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Guh... A step too late...?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you!
I won the championship all thanks to you.”

text_block_list.name: Child Fan
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too...!
Bubble-chan, your run was incredible...!
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Child Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Bubble-chan, watching your cool running
always gives me so much courage...!"

text_block_list.name: Child Fan
text_block_list.text: Whenever things get tough or unpleasant, watching Bubble-chan run makes me feel like I can't give up...!

text_block_list.name: Child Fan
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep cheering for you forever and ever!
I'm definitely going to your next race too!!
I love you!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the wonderful cheers.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I will run.
So that I can keep giving you courage!
The warm cheers of a little fan seemed to grant Bubble Gum Fellow tremendous strength on his journey—
The warm cheers of a little fan seemed to grant Bubble Gum Fellow tremendous strength on his journey—
That night—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list: Great work at the Grand Thanks Festival!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Good work on your end too.
choice_data_list: So what were you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know, my fans' reactions.
I was looking them up a bit on social media and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
What that fan said to me today
made me so incredibly happy...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's not just what's written, either.
I can really feel how much they're 'waiting for me'...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, from around the Japan Cup
up until today, I guess I've been pretty desperate
just focusing on myself.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "My mindset was completely focused on fulfilling the 'Limit Break Plan' and whipping up the Heavenly Kings whirlwind once more—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...I think maybe I wasn't listening closely enough
to the voices of the fans cheering me on."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
But hearing the fans' voices today...
made me want to hear even more voices
of the people waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And when you actually look into it,
there's way more than I expected!

Looking at Bubble Gum Fellow's track record,
there is no doubt that she is among
the Umamusume currently moving this era forward.

There was no way there'd be only a few voices
eagerly awaiting her comeback...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ………………I see. So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then I've got to answer those expectations properly.
At this upcoming Takarazuka Kinen!
choice_data_list: Be as cool as you were in today's event!
Be as cool as you were in today's event, okay!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer,
you thought I looked cool today, didn't you?

I remember the picture-perfect sight
of Bubble Gum Fellow running effortlessly
with a young fan on his back—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Should I carry you on my back too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well, you kind of looked
like you wanted a piggyback ride!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, or would it be better to carry you in front?
Like a so-called 'princess carry'—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha!
Trainer, is your face turning a little red?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Sorry, sorry! But come on—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I was just a little happy that you thought
I was cool!
So I got slightly carried away.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Is that payback?
